## send_confirmation
`POST /webhook/send-confirmation`

**Body:** `business_id` plus the appointment data returned by `create_booking`.

No longer a Vapi-facing tool in the template (create_booking_optional's own workflow is where a real confirmation would be triggered -- see docs/voice-agent.md) but kept and updated here as a standalone internal endpoint. Now requires and resolves `business_id` so the confirmation text uses the real business name instead of a hardcoded one, and so an unknown business_id is rejected rather than silently sending a message with the wrong name. The Twilio node is still a **placeholder** -- no credential, no from-number. It fails on every call and the response honestly says `sent: false`.
